scores.claim_text: CASGEVY (exa-cel) is the first-ever approved CRISPR gene-editing therapy; multi-jurisdictional approvals for SCD and TDT; advanced under JDCA with Vertex.
supports: clinical_trials.query_by_lead_sponsor (Vertex): 244 lead-sponsor trials; CRISPR Therapeutics appears in the Vertex collaborators list — direct registry-level corroboration of the joint development program.
openfda.query_approved_drugs is a NDA Drugs@FDA endpoint; CASGEVY is a CBER cell-therapy BLA so absence here is expected (calibration-heuristic 5 source-jurisdiction) and is NOT a contradiction.
scores.M_check: clinical_trials.query_by_lead_sponsor[Vertex] -> {total_in_registry: 244; collaborators include 'CRISPR Therapeutics'}; openfda.query_approved_drugs[Vertex] -> 9 approved NDAs none = Casgevy (BLA, separate dataset).
scores.M_value: VRTX collab includes CRISPR Therapeutics (corroborated); NDA dataset N/A for biologic.
scores.interpretation: Registry-level corroboration via Vertex's lead-sponsor entry confirms the CRSP/VRTX joint hemoglobinopathies program. CASGEVY's BLA status is well-established in the public domain; openFDA NDA absence is a source-jurisdiction artifact, not a contradiction. PASS.

Both lead-sponsored by 'CRISPR Therapeutics AG'.
Trial-phase ladder claim (Phase 1/2 oncology + Phase 1 autoimmune) is exactly mirrored in ClinicalTrials.gov registrations.

scores.claim_text: Sirius Therapeutics partnership (May 2025): CTX611 (FXI siRNA) in ongoing Phase 2 TKA trial; up to ~$407.5M milestones; 1.84M CRSP shares issued at $38 as partial consideration.
supports: No CTX611-related trial appears with 'CRISPR Therapeutics' as lead sponsor on ClinicalTrials.gov; CRSP's disclosure explicitly says CTX611 was developed under Sirius (so any registry trial would be lead-sponsored by Sirius, not CRSP — consistent with the registry result).

The Sirius share issuance is corroborated within CRSP's own filings (financial-statement footnote, 1,842,105 shares at $38.00). Sirius is a private Chinese biotech with limited US-listed counterparty corroboration available; calibration-heuristic 5 (source-jurisdiction) and 6 (name-variant fragility) apply.
scores.M_check: clinical_trials.query_by_lead_sponsor[CRISPR Therapeutics] -> no CTX611/SRSD107 in studies_sample (5 of 13 returned). Sirius as a private Chinese sponsor would lead the registry entry; trials of CTX611 may be in NMPA registry, not ClinicalTrials.gov.
scores.M_value: Partnership has a balance-sheet shoe (share issuance and biological commitments). Trial-registration is sponsor-of-record dependent and the Sirius lead-sponsorship route is not in CRSP's CT.gov footprint.
scores.interpretation: Partnership existence corroborated by own-filing share-issuance event. Trial registration is jurisdictionally fragile (Sirius is China-domiciled). MODERATE because the operational claim (Phase 2 TKA underway) is not independently verifiable in ClinicalTrials.gov — could be in NMPA/CDE registry only. Not a contradiction but lower verification depth than peer-claims.
